name: bmw
description: Browser is boundary, media is native, web is runtime

scripts.start: npm run build --silent && node scripts/start-electron.js bmw
scripts.test:media-e2e: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/browser-background-smoke.js && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/media-capture-smoke.js && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/media-processing-smoke.js
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-source.ts && npm run check:features && npm run check:architecture
scripts.test:vision-e2e: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/vision-model-smoke.js
scripts.test:video-e2e: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/video-production-smoke.js
scripts.video:arena-case: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/video-production-case.js
scripts.test:tts-e2e: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/narration-smoke.js
scripts.video:skills-case: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/skills-video-case.js
scripts.test:studio-e2e: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/video-studio-smoke.js
scripts.test:driver-e2e: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/agent-driver-smoke.js
